title: Cover — Radio Mega TV
description: Hero cover slide with brand identity
speakerNotes: Open with the big vision: radio, reimagined for the Smart TV era.

title: The Problem
description: Radio has no home on the world's most-used screen
speakerNotes: TV is the dominant screen in 2.5B households. Radio has no native, high-quality presence there.

title: The Solution
description: Radio Mega brings world radio to every Smart TV
speakerNotes: We built a premium radio streaming app purpose-built for the TV remote, not a phone port.

title: The Product
description: Feature walkthrough of the Radio Mega TV experience
speakerNotes: Walk through the key UX pillars: remote navigation, ambient mode, device-code login, cross-device sync.

title: Market Opportunity
description: $18B global online radio market with 2.5B Smart TVs
speakerNotes: The TAM is enormous. Smart TV installs are forecast at 3.4B by 2028. Radio is the killer app nobody has shipped yet.

title: Business Model
description: Four revenue streams: subscriptions, ads, B2B, station partners
speakerNotes: Diversified model protects us. Premium subscription is the anchor; B2B is the growth multiplier.

title: Revenue Projections
speakerNotes: $820K Y1, $3.4M Y2, $10.1M Y3. 72% gross margin target. Conservative assumptions available in data room.

title: Technology Stack
description: Purpose-built for every screen — React, Tizen, webOS, Node.js
speakerNotes: We own the full stack. TV SDKs are notoriously difficult — our in-house expertise is a genuine moat.

title: Platform Strategy
description: TV first, then mobile companion, then web and B2B — phased expansion plan
speakerNotes: TV is the beachhead. Mobile follows as a companion and remote. Web and B2B white-label complete the ecosystem in 2026.

title: Competitive Landscape
description: No direct competitor owns the TV screen for radio
speakerNotes: TuneIn has a TV presence but no proper remote navigation. iHeart and Spotify don't. We are the only premium offering.

title: Traction
description: Two live platforms, 50K stations, 238 countries, 50 languages
speakerNotes: We shipped. This is not a concept — it is in the Samsung Smart Hub and LG Content Store today.

title: Unit Economics
speakerNotes: TV app stores have organic discovery. Our CAC is extremely low. LTV is driven by radio's habitual listening behavior.

title: Brand Identity
description: Premium media brand — logo, color palette, typography
speakerNotes: Radio Mega is a brand, not a utility. That matters for both consumer premium pricing and OEM pre-install deals.

title: Team
description: Founders and advisors behind Radio Mega
speakerNotes: We are hiring senior TV engineers and a Head of Partnerships. This raise funds those hires.

title: Roadmap
description: 12-month plan: Apple TV, Android TV, premium, B2B, Series A
speakerNotes: Q2 done. Q3 is Apple TV and first B2B pilot. Q4 monetization live. H1 2026 is Series A territory.

title: Use of Funds
description: $2.5M seed: engineering 40%, sales 25%, marketing 20%, ops 10%, reserve 5%
speakerNotes: 40% to ship remaining platforms. 25% to close OEM pre-install deals. 20% UA to hit subscriber targets.

title: Financial Summary
speakerNotes: Break-even Q2 2028. Full model in data room. Happy to walk through assumptions.

title: Join Us
description: Closing call to action — $2.5M seed, invest@themegaradio.com
speakerNotes: Radio for the television era. Two platforms live. $2.5M seed. Let's talk.
